mapper.select: SELECT receipt_order_type AS "name", COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM wms_receipt_order WHERE receipt_order_status != -1 GROUP BY receipt_order_type

SELECT COALESCE(i.item_name, '未命名') AS "name", SUM(inv.quantity) AS "quantity", SUM(inv.quantity * COALESCE( (SELECT h.unit_price FROM wms_inventory_history h WHERE h.sku_id = inv.sku_id ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT 1), 0 )) AS "value" FROM wms_inventory inv JOIN wms_item_sku s ON inv.sku_id = s.id JOIN wms_item i ON s.item_id = i.id GROUP BY i.item_name ORDER BY SUM(inv.quantity) DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(create_time, 'MM-DD') AS "date", order_type AS "orderType", SUM(ABS(quantity)) AS "quantity" FROM wms_inventory_history WHERE order_type IN (1, 2) AND create_time >= CAST(#{startDate} AS timestamp) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(create_time, 'MM-DD'), order_type ORDER BY "date"
SELECT COALESCE(inst.quality_grade, '未评级') AS "name", COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM wms_item_instance inst WHERE inst.instance_status = '在库' GROUP BY inst.quality_grade ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM( inv.quantity * COALESCE( (SELECT h.unit_price FROM wms_inventory_history h WHERE h.sku_id = inv.sku_id ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT 1), 0 ) ), 0) FROM wms_inventory inv

SELECT ii.id, ii.instance_code AS "instanceCode", i.item_name AS "itemName", ii.warranty_period AS "warrantyPeriod", ii.warranty_period_months AS "warrantyPeriodMonths" FROM wms_item_instance ii LEFT JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = ii.item_id WHERE ii.warranty_period IS NOT NULL AND ii.warranty_period < #{nextNextMonthStart} ORDER BY ii.warranty_period ASC
